description:
As a new visitor, I want to create an account so I can place orders.

* All required fields filled with valid data → account created and the user can sign in with it.
* An already-registered email → a clear error, and no duplicate account.
* Invalid email format or a password below the minimum length → inline validation errors.
* A customer under 18 years old cannot register.
** Required fields: first name, last name, date of birth, email, password.
** Password must be at least 8 characters.
** Age is calculated from date of birth; under 18 → "You must be at least 18 years old."

criteria.text: All required fields filled with valid data → account created and the user can sign in with it. (Required fields: first name, last name, date of birth, email, password.)
An already-registered email → a clear error, and no duplicate account.
Invalid email format or a password below the minimum length → inline validation errors. (Password must be at least 8 characters.)
A customer under 18 years old cannot register. (Age is calculated from date of birth; under 18 → "You must be at least 18 years old.")

cases.title: Register successfully with all required fields valid and sign in with the new account
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available. No user is signed in.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <first name> and <last name>.
Enter a date of birth of a person aged 18 or over, e.g. <date of birth of an adult>.
Enter <an email address that is not yet registered>.
Enter a password of at least 8 characters, e.g. <password with 8 or more characters>.
Submit the registration form.
Sign out if the system signs the user in automatically, then open the sign-in page.
Sign in with the email and password used in steps 4 and 5.
cases.expected: The account is created and the user can sign in with the registered email and password. (Exact confirmation wording and post-registration screen not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Registration with an already-registered email is rejected and creates no duplicate account
cases.preconditions: <an email address that is already registered to an existing account> exists in the system. No user is signed in.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <first name> and <last name>.
Enter a date of birth of a person aged 18 or over.
Enter <an email address that is already registered to an existing account>.
Enter a password of at least 8 characters.
Submit the registration form.
Check the account list / customer records for that email address.
cases.expected: A clear error is shown stating the email is already registered (exact wording not specified in the story) and no second account exists for that email address.

cases.title: Invalid email format shows an inline validation error
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. No user is signed in.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <first name> and <last name>.
Enter a date of birth of a person aged 18 or over.
Enter an email in an invalid format, e.g. <a string without @ or domain>.
Enter a password of at least 8 characters.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: An inline validation error is shown for the email field (exact wording not specified in the story) and the account is not created.

cases.title: Password shorter than 8 characters shows an inline validation error
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available. No user is signed in.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <first name> and <last name>.
Enter a date of birth of a person aged 18 or over.
Enter <an email address that is not yet registered>.
Enter a password of exactly 7 characters, e.g. <7-character password>.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: An inline validation error is shown for the password field (exact wording not specified in the story) and the account is not created.

cases.title: Password of exactly 8 characters is accepted (minimum length boundary)
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available. No user is signed in.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <first name> and <last name>.
Enter a date of birth of a person aged 18 or over.
Enter <an email address that is not yet registered>.
Enter a password of exactly 8 characters, e.g. <8-character password>.
Submit the registration form.
cases.expected: No password length validation error is shown and the account is created.

cases.title: Customer under 18 cannot register
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available. No user is signed in.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <first name> and <last name>.
Enter a date of birth that makes the customer clearly younger than 18, e.g. <date of birth of a 15-year-old>.
Enter <an email address that is not yet registered>.
Enter a password of at least 8 characters.
Submit the registration form.
Check whether an account exists for the email used.
cases.expected: The message "You must be at least 18 years old." is shown and no account is created.

cases.title: Customer one day before their 18th birthday cannot register
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available. No user is signed in.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <first name> and <last name>.
Enter a date of birth so that the customer turns 18 tomorrow (today's date minus 18 years, plus one day).
Enter <an email address that is not yet registered>.
Enter a password of at least 8 characters.
Submit the registration form.
cases.expected: The age calculated from the date of birth is 17, the message "You must be at least 18 years old." is shown and no account is created.

cases.title: Customer whose 18th birthday is today can register
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available. No user is signed in.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <first name> and <last name>.
Enter a date of birth exactly 18 years before today's date.
Enter <an email address that is not yet registered>.
Enter a password of at least 8 characters.
Submit the registration form.
cases.expected: The age calculated from the date of birth is 18, the "You must be at least 18 years old." message is not shown, and the account is created.

cases.title: Registration is not completed when a required field is left empty
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available. No user is signed in.
steps: Open the registration page.
Fill in all required fields (first name, last name, date of birth, email, password) with valid data except one, leaving <one required field, e.g. last name> empty.
Submit the registration form.
Repeat steps 1-3 leaving each of the other required fields empty in turn.
cases.expected: For each attempt the account is not created because a required field (first name, last name, date of birth, email, password) is missing. (Exact message and its placement not specified in the story.)
